capabilities.paint: disabled unless paint.enabled == true; enabled requires isolated parents.Mask and parents.Blend
capabilities.primary_physics: disabled unless primary_physics.enabled == true; enabled requires asset and nonempty required_sockets
capabilities.fallback_assets: optional coherent mesh/post_process/physics triple; no profile-ID logic

ordering: sort_order (default1000) then id; default:true picks first preferred profile in sorted order, otherwise first; saved/current IDs take precedence

materials.emissive_by_slot: JSON object with zero-based decimal string keys and numbers0..100, overriding role emissive except hidden slots

paint.parents: Mask/Blend exact Unreal object paths, isolated wardrobe namespace
paint.parameters: scalar-name -> finite number -10000..10000; PBZPaintStyle and PaintSurfaceType reserved
paint.surface_types: zero-based string slot keys -> integer0body/1face/2hair/3eye; omitted slots derive explicit role arrays

hide_original.component_names: array added to PBZ original names unless replacement requested; main mesh and weapons rejected
hide_original.asset_roots: array overrides original Hero_Hun roots only
hide_original.asset_fragments: array overrides default original cosmetic fragments; weapon fragments rejected

limitations: PBZ adult-Hun replacement adapter only; original animation class remains
post_process and physics are required cooked isolated wardrobe assets
model.json does not mount, convert or retarget an arbitrary PAK
no ultimate-video addon or native combat adapter support in this standalone Core
